text.en: Nora found a slow drip above the bunks. Three mattresses are wet through. The pipe sweats when the pumps kick, and nobody marked which joint failed.

text.en: Ellis says a Synod prayer is traveling the vents at night. Not from the chapel — from somewhere east of the filters. A few of yours are answering under their breath.

text.en: Mara found a square cut out of the top air-filter mesh. Someone used it for a blanket on the cold rail. The stack still pulls, but dust is getting past.

text.en: Tess and Vic have not spoken in three days. The quarrel is over a shelf: whose tin, whose lamp oil, whose right to the nail in the wall. The platform is quiet around them on purpose.

title.en: A lamp for the fever bunk

text.en: Ruth wants one lamp left on all night over the sick bunk. The generator is already thin. Hal says if that lamp stays, the hydro beds lose an hour at dawn.
text.ru: Рут хочет оставить одну лампу на всю ночь над больной койкой. Генератор и так тянет слабо. Хэл говорит: если лампа останется, гидрогрядки потеряют час на рассвете.

text.en: Owen put his glove on the third rail by the south stair. It is cold. The platform has been running on borrowed heat from the generator room, and tonight even that is thin.
